name: Elmwood Cemetery bur oak

location.address: Historic Elmwood Cemetery, 1200 Elmwood Ave, Detroit, MI 48207 (Bloody Run valley)

access: Cemetery grounds are open to visitors (cemetery office at 1200 Elmwood Ave); free self-guided tree tour maps on the cemetery site. Confirm opening hours before going.
verify_notes: Owner of the ground (Historic Elmwood Cemetery and Foundation) calls it the oldest tree in its Level I ArbNet arboretum (certified 2015, first in Detroit), about 280 years old, in Bloody Run valley. Source: owner's arboretum page (accessed 2026-11-09), one source, owner is enough. No coordinate published; no pin given, cemetery is about 86 acres, so NOT a small site. Alive: the same page captions photos from Arbor Day 2025, no dated photo of this trunk seen. Needs a pin from the cemetery's tree tour map PDFs (image-only PDFs, not OCRed this pass: https://www.elmwoodhistoriccemetery.org/images/9209_elm_treetourss.pdf is the southern sections) or a reader fix. Cemetery predates much of Detroit: its valley is the Bloody Run creek (name from 1763 Pontiac battle) per site name only, not verified here.

name: Elmwood Cemetery sweetgum

location.address: Historic Elmwood Cemetery, 1200 Elmwood Ave, Detroit, MI 48207 (Section O, tree no. 657 per register field note)

official_register.name: Michigan Big Tree Register (Michigan Botanical Society)

access: Cemetery grounds open to visitors; confirm hours with the office.
verify_notes: Michigan Big Tree Register id 1973, verified 2016-11-01: girth 99.6 in (253 cm), height 77 ft (23.5 m), 'Section O near 4-street intersection, #657'. Owner's page says it is Michigan's second largest sweetgum. Two sources (register + owner). Register GPS is rounded to 0.01 degree (42.35,-83.27 is wrong for the cemetery, which sits near 42.35,-83.02), so no usable coordinate: pin missing. Last measured 2016, no recent alive check. Also register 2002/2003 Lombardy poplars (3rd and 4th largest, 2016) and 2065 American elm (185 in, 110 ft, 2016) at the same cemetery: not delivered, poplars short-lived and no recent check.
